title: Aerial survey record altered or missing 1964-1969
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Aerial survey record altered or missing 1964-1969, about 1964-1969 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the aerial record is largely void. It's been deleted from strangely 19 with 1964 to 1969.

plain: A man who speaks as the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch in Utah, says that the photos taken of the property from the air are mostly missing for the years 1964 to 1969. In his words, that stretch of the aerial record has been "deleted," and he mentions people named Dr. Taylor and Eric Barter in telling it. He raises it because, if true, it would suggest that someone wanted those years of the land hidden, on a ranch where he believes something unusual lies underground.
